relationship: Independent native capture owners and bounded frame transfer implement the pinned screencast geometry, JPEG quality, activity and ACK behavior. The pinned browser backend and recorder do not execute Flashwright commands; its loader/viewer are conformance consumers.
scope: Manual screenshots:true only, independently composable with sources:true and existing action/console tracing.
Existing and newly published public pages, multiple pages, closed pages and independent chunks.
Quality90 JPEG, longest-side800/even requested dimensions, 200ms pending-ACK throttle and500ms before/input/after activity.
ownership: Original context/generation provenance survives native delayed dispatch and cannot activate a newer chunk.
Frame tokens are opaque and single-consumption; metadata claims retain native queue bytes until an attachment slot is reserved.
Start/ACK/stop have one owner; uncertain stop retains a quarantined owner through a late reply or page closure.
Per-request expected image length is checked before host attachment allocation; transfer slots remain owned through resource ingestion.
limits: 4MiB per decoded JPEG;128 frames/16MiB encoded per native context;32MiB encoded across an engine;128 page capture owners.
At most min(2,negotiated) native binary transfers and two host transfer-through-ingest owners per engine, one host owner per context.
Existing trace/source resource, archive, deadline and atomic publication bounds apply; overload fails export while preserving ordinary browser outcomes.
differences: Native monotonic arrival timestamps are mapped into the host action clock with a recorded per-chunk request/response interval and uncertainty; compositor wall time remains independent.
Images use content-SHA256 JPEG archive aliases instead of timestamp-based aliases.

CDP device dimensions and JPEG dimensions are retained separately, including full Chrome surface changes around page creation/closure. Exact frame counts or sampled transient sizes are not equated across independent runs.
Private screencast frames bypass unrelated broadcast subscribers, including storage interception.
exclusions: DOM/network snapshots have separate provenance and acceptance; video and automatic runner tracing policies remain unsupported.
Manual trace and local development evidence do not establish full diagnostic parity, all-platform support or a performance claim.
